artworks.title: Le fil d'Ariane
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature with an oversized headpiece. The figure is depicted navigating using a string or filament. The scene shows the figure standing against a fence-like structure in a rocky landscape with billowing clouds or mist in the background. The drawing has detailed textures in both the figure and background, creating a sense of fantasy and surrealism.

artworks.title: The Errand
artworks.medium: etching with printed tone
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman with two children in a rural setting, with a village visible in the background. The artwork uses fine, detailed etching with cross-hatching and contour lines to create texture. The color palette is subdued and monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow to define the figures and landscape. The composition conveys a serene moment of everyday life through meticulous line work and tonal variations.

artworks.title: Chorley Farm
artworks.medium: etching with printed tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with rustic buildings in the foreground, detailed with fine lines characteristic of etching. Trees frame the buildings, with a field in the background leading to a distant house. The monochromatic color palette focuses on black and white tones.

artworks.title: The Farm Yard
artworks.medium: etching with printed tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene with architectural and pastoral elements. The horizon shows dark buildings and a castle on a hill, separating the built environment from the sky. The etching style creates texture on the structures. A person is depicted working on the ground. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones and black. The sky features light cloud forms.

artworks.title: Un Jour de 1ère Représentation
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting comically. One figure wears a tall top hat and formal coat, while the other has a more casual appearance and holds out a bouquet. The exaggerated features on their faces enhance the humor in the scene. The image includes text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Frank Duveneck
artworks.artist: William Unger, after William Merritt Chase
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, with his full body visible behind a chair. He is sitting sideways to the viewer, with his upper body turned slightly to look over his shoulder. His facial features are partially obscured by the chair. The man appears to have a prominent nose and short, curly hair, wearing a large, fluffy hat. He is dressed in a suit with visible cuff details on his sleeves and is holding a pipe, from which smoke is rising. In his other hand, he is holding a piece of paper or a booklet that rests on his knee. The setting suggests an interior space, with a dark background contrasting with the lighter foreground elements. The floor is visible with a few scattered papers lying on it.

artworks.title: The Municipio, Florence
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a historical urban scene with buildings, including a grand tower in the distance. The monochrome artwork features precise linework, capturing architectural details. Figures of people and a horse-drawn carriage are in the foreground.

artworks.title: S.S. Apostoli, Venice
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene viewed from a slightly elevated and diagonal angle near a canal bridge. Close to us, on the left, a bridge arches over the water with ornate railings where several figures gather beneath a canopy. Beyond the bridge are various buildings, including a tall clock tower with a decorative structure on top. The background shows a complex skyline with smokestacks suggesting industrial elements in the distance. The image features detailed etching techniques, showcasing intricate architectural details. The color palette is a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Nobleman
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of red chalk, heightened with white chalk
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a young male figure standing confidently. He is turned to the side, with his right hand resting on a ledge or wall and his left hand on his hip. The figure has short, slightly fluffy hair and a round face with an attentive gaze. He wears a detailed, historically or theatrically inspired outfit with a long, belted garment, pleated design, voluminous sleeves, knee-length pants, and shoes with cross-straps. There is no visible jewelry. The background is simple with shaded tones.

artworks.title: Beuzeval, Embouchure de la Dive (Calvados)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image showcases a coastal scene with a sky filled with intricate clouds, a vast sea, distant land on the horizon, a sandy beach with figures and boats, a coastal village with buildings, and additional figures and architectural elements in the background. The artwork features detailed line work in black and white.

artworks.title: Entrance to Kauterskill Clove, Catskill Mountains
artworks.artist: American 19th Century after John Frederick Kensett
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Acquired through a gift of Emily Sargent and Violet Ormond, 1952)
artworks.description: The image features a landscape painting showing a valley seen from a slightly elevated perspective. The composition includes a stone wall, green grass, fallen leaves, trees lining the right side, small buildings with red roofs nestled among the trees, and a stream flowing through the valley. The sky meets distant dark blue hills at the horizon, with a cloud-filled sky adding contrast. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, capturing the texture of the foliage and the water. The color palette consists of earthy browns, greens, reds, and soft blues.

artworks.title: Crossing the James River
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image is a painting of a river crossing with a barge carrying a horse-drawn cart and passengers. The perspective is elevated, showing the scene from a high angle. The sky is visible at the top with wispy clouds. The painting uses watercolor with soft, flowing brushstrokes blending colors. The color scheme includes soft greens, light blues, earthy browns, and patches of colorful foliage. Hills in different shades of green and brown are depicted beyond the river, leading to a serene mountain range in the background.

artworks.title: In the Red Clay Region
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The painting shows a scene with a rugged terrain and nature. In the foreground, an earthy path leads to a small arched stone bridge over water. A wooden fence runs diagonally in the background. Autumn-colored trees and rolling hills can be seen further back. The painting features soft brushstrokes and a warm, earthy color palette.

artworks.title: Church of Santa Barbara
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountain ranges in the distance and a warm sky. The painting includes detailed architectural elements and vegetation. Two figures in dark attire are conversing in the foreground, with a church and other buildings partially hidden by foliage.

artworks.title: Fraktur House
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1964)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a building facade. The drawing shows a simplistic and stylized architectural facade with two large square windows, a central rectangular doorway, and three circular decorative patterns above the roofline. Additionally, the facade has two tall rectangular patterned elements, a potted plant at the base, and three circular designs with symmetrical, star-like patterns with dots and lines for texture. The color palette includes pink and black. The drawing combines architectural elements and artistic details, giving the facade a folk art or naive art aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Piazzetta, Venice
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image displays a nocturnal scene with a large architectural structure on the left. The building showcases intricate arched windows and illuminated arches. In the background, a tall, slender structure is visible. The horizon is blurred by dim light and a hazy atmosphere typical of a late evening scene. The technique uses soft and blurred brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement. The color palette consists of sepia and black tones, enhancing the atmospheric quality of the night scene. Close to us, shadowy figures are depicted as black silhouettes, emphasizing the contrast between light and dark. The composition conveys depth through light, shade, and the architecture's lines.

artworks.title: Memory of Venice: the Palazzo Ducale and the Piazzetta
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper mounted to wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a view across a body of water towards an illuminated architectural scene. The horizon is marked by the architecture meeting the sky, with a large building with a dome and arches on the right side. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a hazy effect. The color palette is mainly dark shades with subtle highlights suggesting reflected light on the water, contrasting with the luminous areas of the building and light sources.

artworks.title: Bridge, Venice
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of silhouetted figures in an indoor setting. The figures are gathered in a large space, possibly a hallway or atrium. The use of charcoal creates a shadowy and diffused light. The background architecture features hints of gothic arches, adding a historic or grand feel to the scene. A staircase is visible on the right side, adding depth to the space. The drawing conveys movement and activity with the mingling forms, suggesting a bustling environment.

artworks.title: Venetian Bridge
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper mounted to wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge with figures on top, seen from across a body of water. The horizon line is formed by the edge of the bridge. Above the bridge are indistinct architectural elements in the distance. The technique features soft brushstrokes or charcoal creating a hazy effect with blurred lines suggesting figures in motion. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of black and grey, with an interplay of light and shadow. The water reflects these tones, adding to the moody ambiance of the scene.

artworks.title: Reflections, Venetian Canal
artworks.medium: watercolor and conté crayon over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a building next to a canal with a reflection in the water. The horizon is not visible, and a boat is tied near the building. The brushstrokes are rough and textured, and the color palette includes browns, reds, grays, green, and black. The reflection in the water adds a rippling effect.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, No. 15
artworks.medium: crayon on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a stone wall in the foreground, sparse vegetation, and rock formations in the distance. The horizon is low, with hills or mountains in the background against a light sky. The color palette consists of earth tones and the paper is a light blue hue.

artworks.title: Study for "Astronomy"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a nude female figure seated from the hips up. The woman is leaning on her right arm, with her left arm bent and resting on her left knee. Her head is turned to the left, showing a profile view of her face. Her hair is styled with a headband and loosely tied at the back. The drawing is primarily in soft chalk on brownish paper, emphasizing the contours and shading of the body.

artworks.title: Study for "The Fates Gathering in the Stars"
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays curving and flowing lines, creating an abstract composition suggesting the form of figures. The shapes resemble human characters in different poses, reminiscent of classical draped figures. The abstract rendering combines organic shapes of human forms and a textured background.

artworks.title: Study for "Greek Girls Bathing" [recto]
artworks.medium: crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the American Academy of Arts and Letters, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length drawing of a person standing with a slight forward lean, appearing in motion with the head turned to the side and the right arm bent upwards. The individual's features are softly sketched, with long, flowing hair and draped in a robe or flowing garment. The background is plain, and there are no visible accessories or items in hand. The image is created in a style that seems to use chalk or pastel in earthy tones on tan paper, emphasizing contours and texture.
